scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter pk-backend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter pk-frontend exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter pk-transcoder-worker exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter pk-backend build && pnpm --filter pk-frontend build && pnpm --filter pk-transcoder-worker build
